column1: # Words that are not standard Ukrainian: Russian words, surzhyk, misspellings.
# Each row does two things. import_wiktionary.py --translations turns the word down, so it gets no
# entry from the translation tables; and search says about it "not standard Ukrainian", followed by
# the Ukrainian word(s) in the third column, ahead of any VESUM suggests.
# Written by hand: word, a tab, the part of speech as the tables give it (noun, verb, adj, ...; empty
# for every part of speech), a tab, and the Ukrainian word or words to say instead, separated by "|"
# (may be empty). check_russianisms.py lists candidates. Never copy suggestions from VESUM, dict_uk or
# LanguageTool into this file: those lists are under other licences and stay out of nebokrai.db.
# November 2026 draft: the rows come from the 223 entries check_russianisms.py flagged; the Ukrainian
# words were written for the 64 that VESUM has no linkable suggestion for. Both need a native reader.
